metadata.description: The skills Harshit Khemani uses with coding agents, grouped as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: kheskills
plugins.description: Every khe skill except the brains, as one Claude Code plugin: /kheskills:khe-auto, /kheskills:khe-content-engine, /kheskills:khe-demo, /kheskills:khe-design-tokens, /kheskills:khe-diagram, /kheskills:khe-launch-film, /kheskills:khe-package, /kheskills:khe-poteto-pyramid, /kheskills:khe-sound, /kheskills:khe-sticker, /kheskills:khe-svg, /kheskills:khe-ui. The brains are the khe-brain plugin.

plugins.name: khe-brain
plugins.description: Brains: answers from one source's public writing, talks or notes, with the source named. /khe-brain:emil-kowalski, /khe-brain:benji-taylor, /khe-brain:varun-mayya, /khe-brain:isb, /khe-brain:yc, /khe-brain:harshitkhemani, /khe-brain:enrico-tartarotti.
